blocks.title: Edge persistence model

blocks.text: The store derives its data path, timestamps records in UTC, returns an empty edge list when absent, and writes indented JSON while creating parent directories.

blocks.text: Workspace ids are parsed from node prefixes. create_edge rejects missing, self, and cross-workspace links, then appends a generated edge under the process lock.
blocks.title: Validated edge creation

blocks.text: delete_edge removes one matching record or raises FileNotFoundError; get_edge returns one record or raises the same error.

how_it_works: Derives workspace ids from node ids
Reads and writes one JSON file
Filters edges by workspace or node pair
purpose: Edges are persisted separately from semantically searchable vector nodes as a JSON array. Creation validates nonempty, non-self, same-workspace node ids; writes are protected by a process lock, while read queries return matching records.
summary: Stores structured knowledge-graph edges in a locked JSON file and queries them by workspace or node.
